title: docs(locale): restore accents and Japanese punctuation
body:
The locale notes currently teach misspelled words. The Japanese page also ends a sentence with an English comma.

## Summary

- Restore the accents in “résumé”, “niño”, and “mañana” in the locale guide.
- Replace the final comma with “。” in the Japanese setup sentence.

## Scope and check plan

This edits explanatory prose only; translation loading and filenames are outside this PR. Preview both Markdown pages, look for missing-glyph boxes in the accented examples, and check that the Japanese full stop renders after ます.

files.patch:
diff --git a/docs/locale-guide.md b/docs/locale-guide.md
--- a/docs/locale-guide.md
+++ b/docs/locale-guide.md
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 # Localization notes
 
-The resume page keeps the names supplied by translators.
-The Spanish example reads: El nino vuelve manana.
+The résumé page keeps the names supplied by translators.
+The Spanish example reads: El niño vuelve mañana.

diff --git a/docs/ja/overview.md b/docs/ja/overview.md
--- a/docs/ja/overview.md
+++ b/docs/ja/overview.md
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 # 翻訳ノート
 
-設定を保存したら、次へ進みます,
+設定を保存したら、次へ進みます。
